# OCR Platform

Production REST/MCP OCR service with native Mac workers.

## References
- [Worker protocol](https://ocr.dungxbuif.com/worker-protocol.md): enrollment, WSS messages, routing, deployment requirements.
- [OpenAPI](https://ocr.dungxbuif.com/api/v1/openapi.json): public OCR API contract.
- [Mac worker setup](https://ocr.dungxbuif.com/guides/mac-workers): manual app installation and node administration.
- [API guide](https://ocr.dungxbuif.com/api/API_REFERENCE): authentication, submission, result retrieval and limits.

Never include node credentials, enrollment codes, user API keys, or document contents in logs or prompts.
